title: More engines, further drift
summary: A Drifting Engine Block now holds up to 12 coal, and a carriage can carry as many engines as you can fit. They burn one at a time, so every engine you add carries the carriage through more worlds.
highlights: Each engine burns until it runs dry and goes dark, then the next one takes over
The screen shows how many worlds all of the carriage's engines can reach together
Engines already holding more than 12 keep their coal until it burns away
